app.name: VERIFLOW
tab.offload.desc: Secure copy of camera and sound rolls to one or more destinations, with checksum verification and ASC MHL report.
tab.media.desc: Browse, preview and edit media metadata.
tab.player.desc: Frame-accurate playback, logs and markers, sent to reports.
tab.sync.desc: Batch sync by timecode, LTC or waveform.
tab.transcode.desc: Convert to any codec and container, presets and queue.
tab.report.desc: Sound, camera and EDL reports, editable and exportable.
player.open.audio.hint: Polyphonic or mono WAV/BWF files from one take, same sample rate.
player.open.video.hint: Any format FFmpeg can read (ProRes, DNxHR, XAVC, H.264, HEVC, MXF...).
player.timing.hint: Open / first frame / sound ready (since opening) / playback start with sound
player.shortcuts: Space play/pause, J/K/L shuttle, arrows frame by frame, I/O in/out, M marker, Enter stop
offload.title: OFFLOAD
offload.algo.hint: XXH128 recommended: fastest and supported by ASC MHL. * SHA-256 appears in reports but not in the MHL (not in the standard).
offload.not.mhl: Not part of ASC MHL v2: reports only
offload.eject.after: Eject the source after a verified copy
offload.existing.title: Clips already in the destination
offload.existing.checking: Verifying the checksums of the clips already present...
offload.existing.checking.hint: Each clip present is read back, as well as the source, and their checksums compared. Identical clips will not be copied again.
offload.existing.found: Some clips of this source are already in the destinations (interrupted copy?).
offload.existing.complete: All clips of this source are already present and identical to the source.
offload.existing.different.list: Clips different from the source (will be replaced)
offload.existing.do.complete.hint: Identical clips are kept; only missing or different clips are copied and verified.
offload.existing.do.replace.hint: The clips of this source already in the destinations are deleted, then the full copy is done again.
offload.existing.replace.confirm: The clips of this source already in the destinations ({n} files in all) will be deleted, then the full copy done again. Other files are not touched. Continue?
offload.elsewhere.found: A copy of this card was found in another folder (copy interrupted on another day?):
offload.elsewhere.forced: Resuming in the folder of the previous copy.
offload.remove.title: Remove from the queue
offload.remove.active: This copy is in progress: it will be cancelled, then removed from the queue. Clips already copied stay in the destinations (the copy can still be resumed). Continue?
offload.remove.done: Remove this card from the queue? Copied clips, reports and MHL files stay on the drives.
media.add.report.hint: Adds the selected media to the current report (camera report in VIDEO mode, sound report in AUDIO mode)
report.need.project: Reports are saved in the project file. Create or open a project to start.
report.hint.image: Create a camera report, then add video clips: timecodes, frame rate, resolution and fields entered in MEDIA are filled in automatically. You can also select clips in MEDIA and click “Add to report”.
report.hint.sound: Create a sound report, then add WAV files: scene, take, track names (iXML), TC, sample rate and bit depth are filled in automatically. You can also select files in MEDIA and click “Add to report”.
report.delete.confirm: This report will be removed from the project. Media and already exported files are not touched. Continue?
report.add.hint: Edit cells directly; empty fields are left to fill in by hand on the PDF (School template).
report.rows.empty: No take: add media or an empty row.
report.popup.title: Report
report.edl.hint: CMX3600 EDL of the report takes: each clip becomes an event (including its PLAYER ranges and markers)
offload.warn.previous: This card was already copied in this project
offload.warn.continue: Complete files already present will not be copied again: they will be verified again. Continue?
offload.warn.title: Card already copied
offload.hdd: Spinning hard drive detected: the copy will be slower.
offload.howto: Choose a source and at least one destination.
offload.verdict.ok: VERIFIED: every copy matches bit for bit
media.export.working_copy.hint: Copies the media with embedded metadata (iXML for WAV, tags for video). Originals are never modified.
media.howto: Open a folder (card copy, rushes drive) to browse its media.
media.shortcuts: Space or double-click: quick player · Ctrl+A: select all · Shift/Ctrl+click: multiple selection for batch editing
media.select.hint: Select one or more media to view and edit their metadata.
media.need.project: Open or create a project to save changes (they are never written into the originals).
explorer.title: Explorer
offload.drop.source: Drop a card or folder here
offload.drop.dest: Drop a drive or folder here
media.truncated: limit reached: pick a more specific subfolder
logs.title: Logs
logs.need.project: Open or create a project to save markers.
logs.none: No marker. M adds a marker; I then O then M creates a range.
player.sound.hint: Clip sound, in sync at normal speed (muted while shuttling)
player.lut.hint: Display LUT (.cube, .3dl): the file is never modified
player.sound.stalled: Sound does not start on this output: playing without sound. Check the selected audio output.
sound.ltc.muted: Track muted to protect your ears.
media.open.player.hint: Opens the selected media in the PLAYER tab (playback, markers, exports)
logs.need.project.title: Project required
logs.need.project.text: Markers are saved in the .veriflow project file, never in your rushes. Create or open a project to add this marker: it will be added right away.
sound.ltc.title: Audio timecode (LTC) detected
offload.removable.hint: Removable media detected (cards, external drives): click one to use it as source.
